Hi Lisa — quick note ahead of tomorrow's call with a preliminary mapping and owners.

A few clarifications for your team to review:
- Authentication & SSO: We use SAML2.0 + optional OIDC; evidence will be screenshots of IdP config + SAML metadata. Owner: Monica Patel.
- Data at rest encryption: All customer data encrypted using AES-256; KMS keys are customer-isolated in Dedicated/private deployments. Owner: Rohan Mehta (SOC2 artifacts) + Security Eng (internal).
- Access logs and retention: Default logs retained 90 days in hosted; dedicated customers can request longer retention subject to contract. Owner: Marissa Cole (retention requests).

We should confirm whether Hearthstead considers any tokens/PHI to be stored in prompts or attachments — that affects evidence scope for redaction and log sampling.

See attached internal diagram (redacted) — it's high-level but should help. I'll be on the call to walk owners through where the artifacts live and expected handoff formats.

Monica Patel
